description: This file defines the RelationshipObjectHelper class, which provides methods for retrieving relationship data from a SugarBean object and formatting it as JSON API responses.

classes.name: RelationshipObjectHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing JSON API relationship objects from SugarBean instances, providing relationships links and responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with an instance of VarDefHelper.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships for a given SugarBean and constructs a RelationshipResponse with links to related resources.
